blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: concurrency — Tasks making progress over overlapping intervals.
dependency — A task needs another result first.
critical path — Longest dependent chain determining ideal completion time.
race condition — Timing-dependent outcome caused by unsafe shared access.
synchronisation — Coordination of operations using shared state.

blocks.title: Find tasks without dependencies
blocks.text: Dataset download and image processing can operate concurrently if they use separate resources.

blocks.title: Respect the final dependency
blocks.text: Report assembly cannot start until BOTH preparation tasks finish.

blocks.title: Calculate the ideal gain
blocks.text: Sequential 9 minutes, parallel 6 minutes. Actual performance depends on scheduling and resource contention.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict the method
blocks.text: Add all durations for the sequential path: 10 minutes.

blocks.title: Worked example · Check and explain
blocks.text: Run independent checks together, wait 5 minutes, then publish in 2: total 7 minutes.
